benefits.name: Disney Streaming Credit
benefits.description: Up to $7 back each month in statement credits after spending on an eligible Disney+, Hulu, or ESPN subscription with the enrolled card.
benefits.terms: Enrollment required. Credits do not carry over month to month — an unused month is forfeited. Valid only on subscriptions purchased directly at DisneyPlus.com, Hulu.com, or Stream.ESPN.com. Totals up to $84 per year if used every month.

benefits.name: Home Chef Credit
benefits.description: Up to $15 back each month in statement credits on Home Chef meal kit purchases with the enrolled card.
benefits.terms: Enrollment required. Credits do not carry over month to month — an unused month is forfeited. Totals up to $180 per year if used every month.

benefits.name: Purchase Protection
benefits.description: Covers eligible purchases against theft or accidental damage for 90 days from the purchase date, up to $1,000 per purchase and $50,000 per card per calendar year.

benefits.name: Car Rental Loss and Damage Insurance
benefits.description: Secondary coverage for theft of or damage to most rental vehicles when the rental is reserved and paid for with the card.
benefits.terms: Secondary coverage — personal auto insurance applies first. Must decline the rental company's collision damage waiver. Does not include liability coverage. A separate opt-in Premium Car Rental Protection product is available for a flat per-rental fee.

benefits.name: Global Assist Hotline
benefits.description: 24/7 emergency referral and coordination service for medical, legal, and travel emergencies when traveling more than 100 miles from home.
benefits.terms: Referral and coordination only — third-party costs incurred are the cardholder's responsibility.

benefits.name: American Express Experiences
benefits.description: Access to presale tickets and cardmember-only events across music, theater, film, and sports.

earningRates.terms: 3% cash back at U.S. supermarkets on up to $6,000 per calendar year in purchases, then 1%. Excludes superstores, specialty stores, and warehouse clubs.
3% cash back on U.S. online retail purchases on up to $6,000 per calendar year in purchases, then 1%.
3% cash back at U.S. gas stations on up to $6,000 per calendar year in purchases, then 1%.
1% cash back on all other eligible purchases, and on bonus-category purchases after each $6,000 annual cap is reached. Cash back is received as Reward Dollars redeemable as a statement credit.
